result.summary:
PASS. Read the tests myself (not the TEST-DESIGNER report), ran them, applied 20 mutants on a copy outside the project.
RUN: cd tools && npm run check: Prettier ok, lint ok, 493 of 493 pass, fail 0, skipped 0, todo 0 (npm test alone: same 493/0/0/0).
DIFF vs test-before (po4/test-before/test): changed files are only pixel-office-layout.test.js, pixel-office-office.test.js, pixel-office-helpers.js; removed/changed lines '<' = 0 in each, additions only. tools/src is byte-identical to test-before/src (diff -rq empty). FRONTEND-DEV changes (build-before -> test-before) compared before/after against 4.15 p.10: LY-01,02,03,05,06,07,08,09,11(+ext),12, OF-18,20,33,34,36,38(3 forms), PN-12,17, helpers setPanelRects/setPanelInts all match the 'до -> после' table; none weakened: numbers moved to the new geometry (35x22, cell 27, fits flag), OF-18 re-modelled by a step function as the table says (asserts the walker never enters the closed cell and the path differs; control with a cell off the path keeps equal paths), OF-20 checks canvasPoint at min_x 5 and -6, click helpers use layout*24 (same hit, same strength; OF-10/11/20 and PN-18 pass and the M120 mutant fails them). The three FRONTEND-DEV extras outside the table (clickCharacter, PN-18 click, setPanelRects/setPanelInts) are justified by 4.15 p.8 and 14.2: accepted.
COVERAGE TABLE (criterion -> test, each read and each failing under a mutant): 18(a) five windows: browser step Q-18 (4.15 p.11, text attached to the test-designer result summary and complete: 5 windows, cell/figure/font, no page scroll, legend 19 items, plates at desks 5/11/18, 40-desk fallback) + calculation LY-17 (windows 28/35/41/55/27, fits flags) - complements correctly; not a test by design. 18(b) figure>=20 and font>=10: LY-17 (formula from constants, lower bound by -1 cell), OF-39 (read from fillRect/font at cell 27, 19 figures, laptops, chairs, captions); plates OF-42. 18(c) composition: LY-15 (every cell of the 19-desk map, rooms, captions (24,0),(26,12),(35,10), 19 distinct desks, passage row 9), OF-39 (3 captions, data-drawn 19). 18(d) size <=36x22 and exactly 35x22 + wall ring: LY-13; dead rows/columns (separate test): LY-14 (columns exactly 10,16,22, row 9, none adjacent, none at wall) and LY-18 for 22..49; relative position by constants dated 2026-10-06: LY-16 at 19,22,29,36,49; growth: LY-18. 18(e) fit/scroll and fallback 40 desks: LY-17, OF-40 (cell 27, canvas 1404x594, #office-scroll CSS, click on shifted rectangle desks 2/39/21), OF-41. 12 (composition/spacing 144 px > 130): LY-15, LY-05. 16 (legend strip, similarity): OF-41, OF-40, OF-42 (plates, the only drawn departure from the sample). 17(d): LY-17 (2K >= Full HD), OF-41 (cell 28, 980x616; without the band 29), LY-11. Q8, Q11, R3: not touched (service page for the owner, no shop data/addresses/photos) - reason in the test-designer result is correct. Q10: failure paths covered (bad area -> 27/fits=false in LY-17 grid and OF-38; bad widths -> null in OF-42). No skip/todo; tests build journals with fixed times, no network, no ports, no files outside the project; the test files do not touch port 4780 or ~/.sai-pixel-office. Tests are independent: each builds its own layout/journal/page; the files also run alone (node test/<file> directly) and pass.
JUDGMENTS: (1) LY-17 at infinite width: correct - design 4.15 p.5 treats a width that is not a positive finite number as a bad area (27, fits=false) and the code does so; the test asserts fits=true only for finite w>=972, h>=594 (infinite height allowed) and asserts the bad-area result for every other pair, so it is stricter, not weaker; the table wording 'each area >= 972x594' is slightly imprecise for infinite width (note, see findings). (2) LY-18: defining 'no dead lines' by the LY-14 rule (no two in a row, none at the wall; empty columns 10,16,22 and row 9 stay) is correct - it is the 18(d) definition (single passage allowed), and the test additionally pins the empty rows to exactly [9].
MUTANTS (my own runs, copy outside the project at the scratchpad tdv/work, 20 of M113..M132 and variants): M114 ROW_PITCH=4: 8 failed (LY-02,03,04,14,15,18, OF-33, OF-42); M115 COLUMN_PITCH=5: 16 failed (LY-01,02,06,07,08,11,14,15,16,17,18, OF-18,20,34,40,42); M113 OFFICE_HEIGHT=25: 20 failed (LY-13 among them); M116 COLUMN_PITCH=7 (wider gaps, variant): 24 failed (LY-14 among them); M117 partition walkable: 7 failed (LY-06,07,08,09,15, OF-08,18); M118 gap row removed: 10 failed (LY-03,04,06,10,14,15,18, OF-09,18,35); M119 extra empty row between rows (variant): 3 failed (LY-02,15,18); M120 MIN_CELL_PX=26: 12 failed (LY-11,12,17, OF-10,11,20,21,38x2,39,40, PN-18); M121 fitCanvas lower bound 4: 4 failed (LY-11,17, OF-38,40); M122 bad area gives 24: 5 failed (LY-11,17, OF-21,38,39); M123 LABEL_FONT 8px: 3 failed (OF-38,39,42); M124 .legend max-height removed: 1 failed (OF-41); M125 .office-scroll overflow hidden: 1 failed (OF-40); M127 E = floor: 14 failed (LY-01,02,03,04,06,11,16,17,18, OF-20,33,34,40,42); M128 line with one taken column: 2 failed (LY-06, OF-42); M129 plate always: 1 failed (OF-42); M130 plate never: 1 failed (OF-42); M131 plate by all partition cells: 1 failed (OF-42); M132 edge touch counts: 1 failed (OF-42); Extra: RIGHT_WALL=41 (grid wider): 17 failed (LY-13,14, ...). All design-listed expected tests fell (M129..M132 only OF-42, as designed; M124 only OF-41; M125 only OF-40). Each of the required ones is caught: plate always (M129), plate never (M130), partitions by cells (M131), edge touch (M132 and M131), grid larger than the limit (M113, RIGHT_WALL=41 -> LY-13), cell <27 (M120), dead row/column (M115/M116/M119 -> LY-14/15/18), room order via column placement (M115/M127 -> LY-16). Not applied: M126 (extra column to the right) - design expects LY-16/LY-18 and the 22+ desk checks in LY-16 (approach x < 23, extra columns x < 5) cover it by reading; I did not run it.
TREE: sha256 list of tools/src, tools/test, docs/design (85 files) before and after - identical (HASH_SAME); no mutant left in the tree; the full check was green after the mutants. Project git status shows no change by me. The only pixel-office processes alive are the owner's (pid 64405/64421, started 12:55, not mine, port 4780 untouched).
